describe: change which keys move the player, or make it follow the mouse
guide: Keys are checked with keys[pygame.K_LEFT] and so on. Add another key with or, like keys[pygame.K_LEFT] or keys[pygame.K_a]. To follow the mouse, set player.center = pygame.mouse.get_pos() inside the loop.
teach: keys[...] is True while that key is held down, so each line moves the player while its key is pressed.
